html:
King of the Zulu from 1816 to 1828, who turned a small chiefdom into the Zulu Kingdom, the strongest power in southeastern Africa.

He grew up in exile and rose as a soldier under Dingiswayo, ruler of the Mthethwa. With Dingiswayo's backing he took over the Zulu in 1816. His army changes became famous:

  • Regiments of young men grouped by age, living in royal barracks.
  • A short stabbing spear for close fighting, with a large cowhide shield.
  • The "horns of the buffalo" attack, which surrounded the enemy from both sides.

His wars and those of his neighbours were part of the Mfecane, a time of conflict and migration across the region; historians still argue how much of it he caused. Groups fleeing the upheaval founded new states, and the Ngoni moved far to the north. In 1828 Shaka was killed by his half-brothers, and Dingane took the throne.
